plans.idea: Classic three-zone leaderboard in miniature: square badge anchored left, headline+subhead block filling the centre, a well-sized CTA pill on the right with real breathing room from the edge (fixes the current crowding where the headline hits the button and the button kisses the canvas edge).

Message-first strip: shrink the badge to a small brand mark, give the copy the widest possible column so the headline sets large and the subhead stays legible, and close with a compact CTA pill aligned to the text's vertical centre.

Copy leads from the left edge and the brand badge sits beside the CTA as a sign-off cluster on the right, so the strip reads headline, then brand, then action, with the badge and button grouped as one closing unit.
